A leading light in mathematics for much of his life, Terence Tao discusses the crisis being caused by a massive dump on AI proofs.  More links & stuff in full description below ↓↓↓

Our playlist of videos on the current AI issue - https://www.youtube.com/playlist?list=PLVsSL1XVSphg

Terence Tao's excellent blog (featuring many guest posts about AI) - https://terrytao.wordpress.com/

Terence Tao previously on Numberphile - https://www.youtube.com/watch?v=MXJ-zpJeY3E

Our Fields Medal playlist - https://www.youtube.com/playlist?list=PLt5AfwLFPxWIDErJihuPX2S7E-0rnkaeu

Here's the now famous (or infamous) dump of AI proofs - https://github.com/openai/math/blob/main/CONTENTS.md

Terence’s new book Six Math Essentials is available for pre-order - https://www.quantabooks.org/books/six-math-essentials/

Patreon: http://www.patreon.com/numberphile

Numberphile is supported by Jane Street. Learn more about them (and exciting career opportunities) at: https://bit.ly/numberphile-janestreet

We are also grateful for support from the Ben Delo Foundation - https://delo.org/

snippet.description:
Can an academically "average" student with an engineering (B.Tech) and MBA background clear the UPSC Civil Services Examination with History Optional and secure a top 70 rank?

In this honest, in-depth conversation on the LevelUp IAS Toppers' Podcast, Samiksha Dwivedi (AIR 56) breaks down her 5-year journey through 4 Mains, 2 Interviews, setbacks, burnout, and eventual triumph.

From managing study routines with her ever-present tablet to scoring 118+ in Prelims and mastering History Optional historiography through LevelUp IAS test series, Samiksha shares actionable frameworks that every serious aspirant needs. 

📞 Course Enquiry, Call here: 8826496658

🖊 History Optional HOT500+ 2.0: https://www.levelupias.com/courses/upsc-cse-history-optional-through-500-questions/

🎓 Apply For Rs.50,000 Scholarship: https://www.levelupias.com/scholarship-test-for-upsc-gs-foundation/

📖 Get the History Optional Mapping Book here: https://www.levelupias.com/upsc-cse-books/history-optional-mapping-book/

👉Join History Optional Telegram: https://t.me/nikhilhistoryoptional 
👉Join GS History Telegram Channel: https://t.me/nikhilhistoryculture

LevelUp IAS, Karol Bagh Centre
